findings.message: unit manufacturing contract does not match the standalone profile
unit adc rtd_pan.adc has MPN MAX31865AAP+T; expected MAX31865AAP+
unit rref rtd_pan.r_ref has MPN PTFR0805B430RN9; expected RG2012V-431-W-T1

native unit is missing exact RREF MPN RG2012V-431-W-T1
